Package sysmlinjava.states

package sysmlinjava.states
SysMLinJava representations of all classes related to the SysML state and state machine. It includes a class for the state machine itself, as well as classes for states, pseudo-states, transitions, guards, triggers, effects, etc. All classes are "final" and need only be initialized within the context of the SysMLStateMachine to fully specify a state-machine that can serve as the basis of an executable item, part, or port.
